raw_text: Real-time updates from Punjab-Haryana border: Tractor convoys stretching several kilometers at Shambhu and Khanauri. Telegram groups coordinating convoy routes, supply chains, and barricade bypass strategies. Security forces have placed concrete barriers and deployed tear gas launchers. This mobilization was detected on social media hours before any mainstream coverage.
